page.layout: Two columns of Hebrew lexicon entries, left and right, divided by a vertical rule. Running heads above each column. The right column has a centred letter heading. Page number top right. Signature bottom left, and a stray "18." at bottom right.

main_text.l: וַתִּצֹק[?] & effudisti, vel dit, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. יָצַק.
תָּצַר obsidebis, Deut. 2. 9. pro תָּצוּר, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. Rad. צוּר.
תָּצָר obsidebis, vel bit, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. צוּר.
וַתָּצַר & angustia es, vel fuit, תְּצָרִי angustabe-ris, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. ut & 2. sing. fæm. Rad. יָצַר.
וַתָּצַר & custodivisti, vel vit, תִּצְרֵנִי custodies me, נּוֹ[?] eum, fut. Kal, 2. sing. masc. vel 3. sing. fæm. aff. Rad. נָצַר.
תָּצַת[?] incendes, vel det, תִּצָּחֶנָּה succendantur, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. ut & 3. pl. f. Rad. יָצַת.
main_text.head: ת ק
main_text.l: וַתָּקֵא & evomuisti, vel it, (pro תָּקִיא,) fut. Hiph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Vau conv. R. קוא.
תִּקְבֹּ[?] perforabis, תִּקְּבָּנוּ[?] exsecraberis eum, תִּקְּבָּנוּ[?] exsecrator eum, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. aff. R. נָקַב, vel קָבַב.
תִּקָּבֵץ congregaberis, vel tur, fut. Niph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. קָבַץ.
תִּקָּבֵר sepelieris, vel tur, fut. Niph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. קָבַר.
תִּקּוֹד[?] inclinabis, vel bit, pro תָּקוֹד, fut. Kal, 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. קָרַד.
תִּקְּהָנָה obstupescent, fut. Kal, 3. pl. f. R. קָהָה.
וַיִּתָּקָהֵל & congregatus es, vel est, fut. Niph. 2. f. m. vel 3. f. f. Rad. קָהַל.

page.notes: Hebrew words are transcribed from a small, slightly blurred scan. Vowel points and dagesh marks are uncertain in several places and are marked [?]. The printed entries are one line each in this transcription, though some run over two or three printed lines. The "18." at bottom right, on the signature line, may be a page or signature figure; it is not included in the main text. The page number "453" is read from a mirrored-looking digit and is marked [?]. The bottom signature "L11 3" is read as printed and is marked [?].
